cac:PartyName.cbc:Name: International Centre for Migration Policy Development (ICMPD)

cac:ProcurementProject.cbc:Name: Provision of Event Management Services within the scope of BOMCA10
cac:ProcurementProject.cbc:Description:
Dear Madam/Sir,
ICMPD is currently out to tender for the Provision of Event Management Services within the scope of BOMCA10 - ICMPD/22.051/SER/EVENT/BOMCA
Potential candidates that would like to take part in this tender process are invited to "Express Interest" upon which they will be given access to the full tender documentation delivery through ICMPD electronic application platform.
The tender documentation can be accessed from the "My Tenders" area of this website and by selecting the "View Details" button of this project.
For the submission deadline kindly refer to the instructions to tenderers.
Best regards,
ICMPD Procurement and Grants Unit
